diagnostic_audit.policy_separation: W3C governs retention/discard and tokenization, not these Rust error codes, byte spans, cleanliness, or diagnostic multiplicities. Those are project public recovery policy and independently source-characterized implementation expectations.
diagnostic_audit.coordinate_contract: No adapter prefix or suffix. UTF-8 original bytes. intersects requires responsible offset strictly before payload end; recovery_ends_at uses EOF responsible offset with nonempty unit ending EOF; ends_at uses zero-width EOF span. Every vector entry multiplicity1; repeated entries represent separate diagnostics.
